title: Speaker Meeting - Tukaram Mundhe

description: Tukaram Mundhe, the prominent IAS officer currently serving as the Commissioner of the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) in Maharashtra, has been a frequent highly anticipated speaker across various civic and leadership events in Mumbai, including forums organised by Rotary international clubs. Total Six club from District 3141 jointly kept the speaker meeting of Tukaram Mundhe at YB Chavan Auditorium.
